name: Disaster Mitigation and Management
description: Definition and classification of hazards and disasters; Understanding the risk, vulnerability and resilience; Multi-hazard risk and vulnerability of infrastructure; Disaster management cycle – mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery; Early warning systems and hazard monitoring; Disaster mitigation strategies and resilience building; Insurance and reinsurance in disaster risk management; Community-based disaster risk reduction; Role of technology in disaster management; Role of government and multilateral organizations and financial institutions in disaster response and recovery; Case studies.
